description: This file defines the LeaveConfigurationService class, which extends ConfigService and provides methods to get and set various leave-related configuration values, such as entitlement strategies, work schedule implementation, leave period status, and whether the leave period is defined within the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

classes.name: LeaveConfigurationService
classes.description: A service class to manage leave configuration settings within the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave entitlement consumption algorithm setting.

methods.name: getWorkScheduleImplementation
methods.description: Gets the configured work schedule implementation setting for leave calculations.

methods.name: includePendingLeaveInBalance
methods.description: Checks if pending leave should be included in leave balance calculations.

methods.name: setLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Sets the current leave period status.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period status.

methods.name: setLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Marks whether the leave period has been set.

methods.name: isLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks if the leave period has been defined.
